verdict.rationale: Bench positions itself as a destination for businesses moving off other accounting tools: 80% of clients switched from DIY software, a testimonial says the team "transitioned my books", and a QBO-certified option works inside the customer's existing QuickBooks account. Historical periods are covered by human-led catch-up bookkeeping rather than a documented data migration. missing for 10: any documented import or migration path from other accounting systems, evidence that historical transaction-level detail (line items, attachments, categories) is preserved rather than reconstructed, a description of supported source systems, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
